source: resident.com and HOLA! USA Nov 2026 guides; organizers' sites

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Los Angeles this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: L.A. Zoo Lights
items.blurb: Illuminated animal sculptures, glowing paths and projections, with a skating rink and Santa visits.
items.blurbEs: Esculturas de animales iluminadas, senderos brillantes y proyecciones, con pista de patinaje y visitas de Santa.

items.name: Enchanted: Forest of Light
items.addr: 1418 Descanso Dr, La Cañada Flintridge, CA 91011
items.blurb: A nighttime walk through illuminated gardens and art installations, now in its 10th year.
items.blurbEs: Un paseo nocturno entre jardines iluminados e instalaciones de arte, en su décimo año.

items.name: Christmas at The Grove tree lighting
items.addr: 189 The Grove Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90036
items.blurb: The 25th tree lighting with live performances, fireworks, a drone show and falling 'snow'.
items.blurbEs: El encendido número 25 con espectáculos, fuegos artificiales, drones y 'nieve'.

items.name: Enchant Los Angeles
items.blurb: A light maze of huge illuminated sculptures, plus an ice-skating trail and holiday market stalls.
items.blurbEs: Un laberinto de luces con esculturas gigantes, sendero de patinaje y puestos navideños.

items.name: Holidays at Universal Studios Hollywood
items.addr: 100 Universal City Plaza, Universal City, CA 91608
items.blurb: Grinchmas in Whoville, Christmas in the Wizarding World and a nightly projection show on Hogwarts Castle.
items.blurbEs: Grinchmas en Villa Quién, Navidad en el Mundo Mágico y un espectáculo nocturno en el castillo de Hogwarts.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in Los Angeles: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Swiss Winter Village
items.addr: 200 Santa Monica Pier, Santa Monica, CA 90401
items.blurb: A Zurich-style market with 60+ chalets, Swiss food and drink, live music and an oceanfront ice rink.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado al estilo de Zúrich con más de 60 casetas, comida suiza, música y una pista de hielo frente al mar.

items.name: Holiday Ice Festival & Village
items.addr: 800 W Olympic Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90015
items.blurb: Outdoor skating beside a holiday village of 20+ market vendors, food and Santa's Workshop.
items.blurbEs: Patinaje al aire libre junto a un pueblo navideño con más de 20 vendedores, comida y el taller de Santa.

items.name: Ovation Hollywood Holiday Market
items.blurb: A family-friendly market of women-owned small businesses, plus crafts, screenings and Santa photos.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado familiar de pequeños negocios de mujeres, con manualidades, películas y fotos con Santa.
